title: Valid SMS acceptance

actions:
1. Submit the body with Idempotency-Key.
2. Read the response status, Location header and body.
3. Query the message row as the test harness (not as a caller).

expected_oan: Exactly one message row in accepted, committed before the response; text and recipient stored encrypted.
expected_provider: No provider call made by the API process.
evidence: Response capture with the credential redacted; row count; test log.

title: Acceptance is durable across a service restart
requirement: A 202 means the message is durably stored; it survives an API restart and is later dispatched exactly once (DOC-02 §6.1).
prerequisites: Dev environment with the API and PostgreSQL deployed; worker able to run with a mocked or sandboxed provider.
actions:
1. Submit and record the 202 id.
2. Restart the API process (and the database connection pool).
3. GET the id.
4. Start the worker against a mock provider.
expected_caller: GET after restart returns the same id with status accepted; later sent.
expected_oan: Row present after restart; one attempt; content purged after sent.
expected_provider: Exactly one provider request for the message.
evidence: Responses before and after restart; attempt count; mock provider request log.
cleanup: Remove test rows or drop the dev schema per DevOps procedure.
